svg.text: Keyword-family matrix (maintainers): every language against every family
2,936 cells have a rule: 207 measured against a parser, 1,751 decoy test only, 978 not tested; 2,320 cells are N/A. Hover a cell for numbers. The README figure is the summary of this.
decoy: comment and string both ignored
Parser cells: colour = the lower of recall and precision. Faded: under 10 functions. Hatched: corpus not pinned (exploratory).
